messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1 1: microlaunch plan: X image post + 3-tweet thread, LinkedIn longform next day, 18s demo clip. Need 2 headline variants, 2 hero images, trimmed clip, UTMs, and HubSpot mapping. Assets by Mon 3pm PT.
Ike: I can create hero images and export 1920x1080 slides. Which stat should live on-image?
Rosa: Put the cost stat on the hero ("~40% lower inference cost"); call out 2x throughput in the thread. That targets finance + eng.
Devon: I'll write copy variants: A = metric-first, B = customer-story. Will keep first line <280 chars for X preview and include UTM placeholders utm_campaign=launch_micro utm_content=A|B.
Maya: For scheduling propose: X Tues 9:30am PT, follow-up thread + clip 2h later, LinkedIn Wed 10am PT. Buffer scheduling ok?
Ike: Yep. Will label files hero_A/hero_B and clip_A/clip_B so analytics maps variants.
Maya: Inbound routing: registrants -> HubSpot contact tagged launch_micro with property social_variant; attendees -> SDR hot leads and notify #sales-inbound. Ops, can you map Segment event social_variant -> HubSpot property?
ops-bot: Created test workflow wf_microlaunch. Reminder: include key "social_variant" in the registration payload. Webhook to #sales-inbound configured.
Rosa: Uploaded drafts: https://files.red/heroA.png and https://files.red/demo18s.mp4. Clip needs 1.2s end-frame CTA and volume lowered.
Ike: Trimmed clip, added CTA, compressed for X (<12MB). Upload: https://files.red/demo18s_final.mp4.
Devon: Posted copy drafts: https://docs.red/copyA and https://docs.red/copyB. Added UTM shortlinks go.red/microA and go.red/microB.
Maya: Engagement follow-ups: write 3 quick reply templates (thanks, question, demo invite) and a 48h outreach for commenters -> SDR nurture. Devon can draft?
Devon: On it. Will add templates to the doc and flag for CM review.
Maya: QA checklist: alt text, UTMs, analytics variant labels, Buffer drafts queued, HubSpot workflow test pass. Please tag me when queued.
Ike: Drafts queued in Buffer, tagging Maya for approval.
Rosa: Product quote requested for LinkedIn longform, pinged product for 2 short lines. ETA 4h.
Maya: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket:
